name: MULPHA
recent: MULPHA 近期出现多项企业活动：子公司认购 SHK Latitude Alpha Fund 700 万美元，并拟出售 New Pegasus Holdings Limited 全部股权。执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 在 10 月多次申报减持股份。公司已发布 2025 年报，并公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩。
notable: 间接全资子公司 Mulpha Strategic Limited 于 2026 年 9 月 1 日认购 SHK Latitude Alpha Fund 700 万美元（约 RM28.28 million）。
间接全资子公司 View Link Global Limited 拟出售 New Pegasus Holdings Limited 全部股权，公司于 2026 年 10 月 30 日补充披露资料。
执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 于 2026 年 10 月 15 日、22 日及 23 日申报减持公司股份。
risks: 执行主席 Lee Seng Huang 在 10 月多次申报减持股份，包括 10 月 15 日减持 200 万股及 10 月 22 日、23 日各减持 100 万股。

Mulpha invests RM28mil in SHK Latitude Alpha Fund

recent_en: MULPHA has seen several corporate activities recently: a subsidiary subscribed USD7 million in SHK Latitude Alpha Fund and proposed to dispose of its entire equity interest in New Pegasus Holdings Limited. Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang reported multiple share disposals in October. The company released its 2025 annual report and announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Mulpha Strategic Limited subscribed USD7 million (approximately RM28.28 million) in SHK Latitude Alpha Fund on 1 September 2026.

Indirect wholly-owned subsidiary View Link Global Limited proposed to dispose of its entire equity interest in New Pegasus Holdings Limited; the company provided additional information on 30 October 2026.
Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang reported disposals of company shares on 15, 22 and 23 October 2026.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Lee Seng Huang reported multiple share disposals in October, including 2 million shares on 15 October and 1 million shares each on 22 and 23 October.
